name: Exterior Siding Prime Coat
intent: Single prime coat. Spray at 350 SF/hr, backroll at 350 SF/hr (coupled), brush/roll at 100 SF/hr.
doctrine: Single prime coat for siding. Spray and backroll are separate tasks (two painters or sequential). Spray_backroll method fires both spray AND backroll tasks. Siding profile modifier handled at scenario level.
